body:
marta: Scheduling the SDK v3.2 rollout for Tue 2024-05-07 @ 14:00 UTC. This thread to confirm owners, smoke thresholds, rollback steps, and client comms. Please ack and call out conflicts.

kyle: I can cut the hosted change and own the routing job during the window. Ill be monitoring logs + metrics.

akash: Ill handle canary hosts and autoscaler tuning. Plan: heat the caches, KV prefix warmup, then allow 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30m. Will report priming output.

devon: Ill run the smoke checks. Quick pre/post commands Ill run:
````
# sanity
curl -sSf -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' | jq -r '.choices[0].text'
pytest tests/smoke/test_chat.py::test_basic_flow -q -k smoke
````
Smoke harness will fail the progression if 95p latency > 450ms or error rate > 0.5%. Will publish the test matrix as a gist in ~1h.

release-bot: Ticket RL-4823 created. Rollout flags: sdk_v3_2_rollout_disable. Canary schedule: 5% (t=0) -> 25% (t=10m) -> 100% (t=30m).

sophia: Compat notes: No model schema changes. Header rename X-Client-Id -> X-Redwood-Client (compat shim in front proxy). Deprecated header will be accepted with a 90-day notice header. Also added NEW_RETRY_BEHAVIOR opt-in header; default unchanged.

marta: Devon, please ensure the smoke job posts a structured line in #eng-releases on success/fail (e.g., `[SMOKE] step=chat_basic latency_ms=420 errors=0.1% -> PASS`). If fail, hard stop and we do rollback.

devon: Will do. Smoke will react with :thumbsup: on pass. Example fail log format: `[SMOKE] step=chat_basic latency_ms=512 errors=0.7% -> FAIL`.

aaron: Rollback runbook: flip feature flag `sdk_v3_2_rollout_disable` to ON, revert router weights, and cut a quick patch if needed. Steps: 1) infra toggle 2) router revert (kyle) 3) notify SRE + customers. Ill own the flag flip.

kyle: Confirmed Ill run the router revert and do regional health sweeps if we roll back. Ill also keep an eye on propagation delays across edge nodes.

priya: Drafted client comms and migration notes at https://docs.internal/redwood/sdk-migration/v3-2 (private). Recommend: email top 50 integrators + 7-day in-app banner. Also prepping changelog blurb.

ben: Quick Q: Any user-facing feature gates for beta customers during canary? Who toggles them if so?

sophia: No new customer-visible feature flags. The only opt-in is the retry header. Internal rollout flag handled by aaron/kyle.

marta: Current owners (please thumbs up to accept): Hosted cut = kyle; Canary + autoscale = akash; Smoke harness = devon; Rollback flag = aaron; Comms = priya; Compat docs = sophia. Confirm by Mon 12:00 UTC so I can finalize the deploy playbook.

kyle: :thumbsup: Im in.

akash: :thumbsup: Ill be online.

devon: :thumbsup: gist with smoke matrix coming: https://gist.github.com/devon/smoke-v3-2

aaron: :thumbsup: standing by for flag flip.

priya: :thumbsup: sent draft to marta for review.

sophia: :thumbsup: noted the retry header opt-in.

marta: Thanks. Final checklist reminder for Monday 12:00 UTC: exact smoke commands, runbook link, owner's pager rotations, and the customer email list. If anyone needs to swap, flag it here. :rocket:

release-bot: Reminder scheduled: RL-4823 preflight check at 2024-05-06T12:00Z.

ben: If we expect any short downtime for clients that don't handle 429s well, we should call that out in the comms.

priya: Good call. Ill add a "retry/backoff guidance" section to the migration doc and include expected transient 429/503 guidance.

marta: Perfect. Ill publish the rollout playbook to #eng-releases Mon 12:30 UTC. Ping me directly for urgent swaps.
